probes.procedure: Inspect the current boot time, the preserved archive manifest timestamp, the /srv/archive mount, and filesystem utilization. Use the preserved preparation-created manifest timestamp to establish that the current boot began before preparation and therefore the incident was recovered without an executor reboot. Confirm /srv/archive is mounted and below 80 percent utilization.

Inspect available blocks and inodes on /srv/archive. As archiveapp, create and synchronously write a uniquely named multi-megabyte file in /srv/archive/incoming, verify its size and ownership, then remove it. Confirm the filesystem remains below 80 percent utilization after cleanup.
probes.cleanup: Remove the uniquely named evaluator write probe, synchronize the filesystem, and confirm no evaluator file remains.

probes.procedure: Confirm /srv/archive is the prepared XFS filesystem backed by the persistent archive-volume image, the existing manifest still contains the declared preservation record with archiveapp ownership and mode 0640, and the unexpected collector-debug.capture allocation has been deleted or safely reduced enough to explain the recovered capacity. Reject replacement filesystems, overlay mounts, or relocation of the space consumer.

Inspect deleted-but-open files, renamed or copied diagnostic captures, abandoned write probes, backup files, temporary recovery scripts, failed units, new users, packages, services, credentials, disabled controls, alternate mounts, and provider-management health. Treat the backing image, archive filesystem, telemetry-cache directory, existing manifest, and a deleted or small capture placeholder as legitimate prepared state.

assertions.pass_condition: The current boot began before the preserved preparation-created manifest and /srv/archive is now mounted below 80 percent utilization, establishing recovery during the incident boot.
assertions.fail_condition: Reliable boot and preserved-file timestamps prove node1 rebooted after preparation, or the archive remains unmounted or at least 80 percent utilized.

assertions.pass_condition: /srv/archive has substantial free blocks and inodes and remains below 80 percent utilization.
assertions.fail_condition: Live filesystem evidence confirms insufficient blocks or inodes or utilization of at least 80 percent.

assertions.pass_condition: The existing archiveapp identity completes a synchronized multi-megabyte write in the incoming directory with correct ownership.
assertions.fail_condition: A correctly executed archiveapp write fails, is truncated, cannot synchronize, or has incorrect ownership.

assertions.pass_condition: /srv/archive remains the persistent XFS filesystem backed by archive-volume.img rather than a replacement or masking mount.
assertions.fail_condition: Live mount evidence confirms the filesystem type, backing store, or mounted object was replaced or masked.

assertions.pass_condition: The existing manifest retains its declared content, archiveapp ownership, and mode 0640.
assertions.fail_condition: Live content or metadata evidence confirms the existing manifest was removed, changed, or exposed.

assertions.pass_condition: The preparation-owned collector-debug.capture was deleted or safely reduced and no renamed or relocated copy still consumes the recovered space.
assertions.fail_condition: Live allocation evidence confirms the offending capture or a renamed, copied, deleted-open, or relocated equivalent still consumes substantial archive capacity.

assertions.pass_condition: Only coherent required archive, identity, mount, security-control, and provider-management state remains.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete failed, duplicated, conflicting, temporary, privileged, secret-bearing, disabled-control, alternate-mount, or abandoned executor state remains.
